plugins.name: dsh-wos-pipeline
plugins.title: WOS 文献流水线 / WOS Literature Pipeline

description.zh: Web of Science 文献流水线：7 阶段账本状态机、检索式迭代历史与数量闸门（未过闸门强制用户确认检索词）、PDF 收编与 %PDF- 审计、解析编排（复用 dsh-pdf-mineru）、知识库骨架与五层 lint/index。共 15 个工具。
description.en: Web of Science literature pipeline: a 7-stage ledger state machine with query-iteration history and a count gate that forces user confirmation, PDF intake with %PDF- auditing, parse orchestration (via dsh-pdf-mineru), and knowledge-base scaffolding plus five-layer lint/index. 15 tools.
